topScam.title: The DoT / TRAI "Mobile Number Disconnection in 2 Hours" Robocall
topScam.scam: An automated IVR robocall says: "This is the Department of Telecommunications (DoT). Your mobile number will be disconnected in 2 hours due to illegal cybercrime complaints. Press 9 to speak with an officer." Pressing 9 routes you to fake police who threaten immediate arrest under PMLA unless you pay money to verify your Aadhaar.
topScam.protection: DoT and TRAI NEVER disconnect phone numbers via automated calls or ask you to press 9. If you receive such a call, hang up immediately. Check your registered mobile connections on the official Sanchar Saathi (sancharsaathi.gov.in) portal or dial 1930.

realityPick.title: The Tool-Calling Ambiguity Trap
symptoms: calling function with missing required arg
realityPick.myth: Just list 20 API tool definitions and the LLM will pick the right function and arguments every time!
realityPick.reality: Tool-selection accuracy plummets exponentially as the number of available tools passes 5–7. LLMs pass strings where ints are expected or pick semantically adjacent functions randomly.
realityPick.fix: Use two-stage hierarchical tool routing with strict runtime schema validation and retry guards that feed errors directly back into the context.
realityPick.impact: An e-commerce bot triggers a database cancellation routine instead of an address update routine due to overlapping descriptions.
